purifier_key.title: Connect your Birdie Podium
purifier_key.description:
Home Assistant needs the local key of this Podium to control it on your network.

1. In the Birdie app, find the device ID and local key of this Podium.
2. Long-press the local key to copy it.
3. Paste it below.

This Podium: device ID `{device_id}`, IP address {host}.

Tip: open Home Assistant on the same phone to paste it straight away.

data_description.local_key: 16 characters, exactly as shown in the Birdie app. It changes whenever the Podium is added again in the app.

purifier_manual.title: Add Birdie Podium
purifier_manual.description:
Long-press the device ID and the local key in the Birdie app to copy them, and paste them here.

Leave the IP address empty and Home Assistant searches your network for this Podium. Some routers block that search even when everything is on the same network: if the Podium is not found, enter its IP address, which you find in your router's list of connected devices (in its web page or app).

data_description.host: Optional. Needed when Home Assistant cannot find the Podium on its own. Find it in your router's list of connected devices; the name shown there may not mention Birdie.

purifier_not_found.title: Add Birdie Podium
purifier_not_found.description:
Home Assistant did not find a new Podium on your network. Some routers block the search, even when everything is on the same network.

Long-press the device ID and the local key in the Birdie app to copy them, and paste them here. Leave the IP address empty at first: Home Assistant then searches once more for this device ID. If it is still not found, enter the IP address, which you find in your router's list of connected devices (in its web page or app).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Podium
reauth_confirm.description:
{name} no longer accepts its local key. This happens when the Podium is added again in the Birdie app, which gives it a new key.

In the Birdie app, long-press the local key of this Podium (device ID `{device_id}`) to copy it, and paste it below.
